C1364.title: Thetanuts Finance Flash Loan Attack
C1364.summary: On June 15, 2026, Thetanuts Finance suffered a flash loan attack, resulting in a loss of approximately $2.1 million. The attacker exploited a mathematical flaw in its index token system, completing the attack within a single transaction using a flash loan. Most of the funds were reportedly recovered by a white hat hacker.

references.title: $2.1M Exploit Hits Thetanuts: Inside the Latest DeFi Flash Loan
